# Test Fixtures

This directory contains sample sheet music images for testing the OMR MCP server.

## Required Fixtures

To run integration tests, add the following sample images:

- `simple_score.png` - Simple single-staff melody (8 measures)
- `piano_score.png` - Two-staff piano score
- `satb_score.png` - Multi-voice choral score (SATB)

## Notes

- Use high-resolution images (300+ DPI) for best results
- Clear, printed scores work better than handwritten
- PNG format is preferred for lossless quality
